description: This file contains utility functions for filtering superblocks, blocks, and challenges in a curriculum structure, as well as functions for matching closest filter options based on string similarity.

methods.name: filterByBlock
methods.description: Filters the superblocks array to include at most one superblock with the specified block dashedName.

methods.name: filterBySuperblock
methods.description: Filters superblocks to include only those with specified names, supporting comma-separated list.

methods.name: filterByChallengeId
methods.description: Filters superblocks to include only challenges matching a specific challenge ID and their subsequent challenges.

methods.name: createFilterPipeline
methods.description: Creates a pipeline of filter functions to apply sequentially.

methods.name: closestMatch
methods.description: Finds the best string match for a target string within a list of strings using string similarity comparison.

methods.name: closestFilters
methods.description: Finds the closest matching superblock or block name based on string similarity, if multiple options are not provided.
